messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
An Kara Kashe Bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa Duk da Sa Dokar Kulle, Atiku Ya Maida Martani Mai Zafi

output.original_text: An Kara Kashe Bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa Duk da Sa Dokar Kulle, Atiku Ya Maida Martani Mai Zafi
output.joy: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi da farin ciki!
output.sadness: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi da takaici mai zurfi.
output.fear: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi da damuwa akan tsaro.
output.anger: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi da fushi mai yawa!
output.surprise: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, abin mamaki!
output.disgust: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi da rashin jin daɗi.
